issues.title: Change from baseline is left missing on baseline records without a documented rule
issues.summary: Define-XML states CHG = AVAL - BASE with no condition; the specification and the Pilot 3 program adadas.r compute it only on non-baseline records, so the literal rule differs from the reference.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADADAS.CHG: "AVAL - BASE", with no condition; ADRG pages 17, 45 and 48 add none.
issues.observed: The specification sets CHG only when ABLFL <> 'Y'; adadas.r lines 164-168 restrict derive_var_chg to is.na(ABLFL). The literal rule differs on 3800 of 12463 records; the non-baseline reading matches all.
issues.action: Decide whether baseline records keep a missing CHG; if so, add the ABLFL condition to Define-XML ADADAS.CHG. The CR-8 contradiction is disputed: a program is not a retained document.

issues.title: Percent change conditions for baseline and zero-baseline records are undocumented
issues.summary: Define-XML states PCHG = 100* (CHG/BASE) with no condition; the specification and adadas.r leave it missing on baseline records, and no document says what PCHG is when BASE is zero.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADADAS.PCHG: "100* (CHG/BASE)"; no retained document adds a baseline-record condition or a zero-baseline policy.
issues.observed: The specification sets PCHG only when ABLFL <> 'Y' AND BASE <> 0; adadas.r lines 169-173 restrict derive_var_pchg to is.na(ABLFL). The literal formula was not probed: it divides by zero on zero-baseline records.
issues.action: State in Define-XML ADADAS.PCHG the intended value on baseline records and when BASE is zero. The CR-8 contradiction is disputed: adadas.r computed the reference and is not a retained document.

issues.title: Analysis visit windows are not stated in any retained document
issues.summary: Define-XML delegates AVISIT windowing to SAP Section 8.2, whose applicability to Pilot 3 is pending review; the specification windows records on study-day intervals that no retained document gives.
issues.expected: Define-XML ADADAS.AVISIT: "Derived based on windowing algorithm described in SAP, Section 8.2"; ADRG page 11 says visits are placed by visit date and windows, with no boundaries.
issues.observed: The specification assigns Baseline for ADY <= 1, Week 8 for 2-84, Week 16 for 85-140 and otherwise Week 24, including a missing ADY; adadas.r lines 67-76 hold the case_when windows of the reference.
issues.action: Confirm which SAP governs Pilot 3 and cite its Section 8.2 windows, or document the study-day windows and the handling of a missing ADY directly.
